name: Azure Thread
description: Pull a bright thread of qi from the fingertip and lash it at a target in clear view.

name: Soaring Brace
description: Rise on the toes with qi lifting the chest so a blow glances off a body held high.

name: Azure Loop
description: Carry a loop of qi under the feet and swing wide round a foe in a single sweep.

name: Azure Perceiving
description: Spread a high clear sense of qi to read where each fighter stands and how strongly they glow.

name: Plunge Pulse
description: Drop the whole body onto a downward blow and let a pulse of qi follow the fall into the target.

name: Hawkwing Sweep
description: Sweep one arm wide like a wing to turn a blow aside and cut back across the opening.

name: High Mend
description: Pour clear high qi into a wounded ally or yourself until bleeding stops and torn tissue closes.

name: Stooping Current
description: Dive along a narrow current of qi and pierce a guard at the end of the descent.

name: Azure Vault
description: Spread a broad vault of qi overhead that shelters allies from falling blows and thrown force.

name: Hawkfall Pulse
description: Leap on a vast surge of qi and fall onto the target so the pulse breaks over the whole ground around it.

name: Twin Coil
description: Wind one coil in each arm and strike with both in a single crossing motion.

name: Mirrored Loop
description: Match the foe's blow with the opposite turn of a loop so it slides off along the arm.

name: Twin Count
description: Count two pulses at once in the left and right wrist to read balance and reserve.

name: Crossing Pulse
description: Cross two pulses through one point of the foe's body so their own flow stutters and their stance slackens.

name: Twin Knit
description: Run both circuits through a hurt ally or yourself so mending qi flows in from both sides.

name: Parallel Layering
description: Draw two parallel layers of qi over the body that each take a share of a heavy hit.

name: Doubled Surge
description: Send one surge from each circuit and let them meet ahead as a single enormous push.

name: Twin Release
description: Open both circuits through an ally to carry off taint and sour backlash from both sides at once.

name: Circuit Rupture
description: Loose both circuits at full tilt so they tear across the field and shake loose the flow of all caught in it.

name: Tandem Palm
description: Strike with one palm while the other holds the field so both work in tandem.

name: Tandem Brace
description: Set the stance and the field together so a push meets two layers of resistance.

name: Tandem Glide
description: Move body and field together in one glide so the guard never breaks while stepping.

name: Tandem Gauge
description: Hold two fields over a space and compare their pressure to find a hidden body in it.

name: Tandem Lash
description: Whip both fields' edges out together so the lash falls twice on the same spot.

name: Tandem Seal
description: Press both fields onto a foe's qi centre to stop their techniques for several breaths.

name: Tandem Mend
description: Rest both fields over wounded allies at once so each is mended by a warm shared flow.

name: Tandem Burst
description: Burst both fields outward together in a heavy ring that clears the ground around the user.

name: Tandem Anchor
description: Anchor one field to the earth round a foe and the other round yourself so they cannot close.

name: Tandem Dominion
description: Press both fields down over the whole fight so that foes in them are weighed down and slowed.

name: Azure Throbbing
description: Strike on the rising edge of the pulse so the whole beat of qi lands in the blow.

name: Azure Cover
description: Let a calm azure pulse spread across the skin and blur the force of a landing blow.

name: Azure Count
description: Count a nearby fighter's pulse and note its speed to judge their fitness and fear.

name: Azure Knock
description: Knock a narrow pulse of qi through a guard so it lands in the muscle behind.

name: Azure Sway
description: Sway the body on the beat of the pulse and slip two paces to the side.

name: Azure Ease
description: Ease a hurt ally or yourself with slow pulses of qi that settle the pain and speed healing.

name: Azure Swell
description: Raise the pulse to its crest then let it break across the foe in a wave that scatters their guard.

name: Azure Purge
description: Beat a clean pulse along an ally's channels and force out poison and taint with each swell.

name: Azure Zenith
description: Draw the great pulse to its peak over a long breath and loose it in a wave that crosses the whole fight.

name: Track Inhale
description: Draw breath down the inward track so the qi gathers deep and the limbs fill with it.

name: Inward Track
description: Pull qi inward along the track and set the body hard against a coming blow.

name: Outward Track
description: Push the held qi out along the arm and into the target with an outward breath.

name: Track Hop
description: Hop from the inward track to the outward on a breath to change direction at once.

name: Track Lash
description: Throw the outward track as a lash that reaches a foe beyond arm's length.

name: Track Net
description: Weave inward and outward tracks into a net that closes round a foe's limbs.

name: Track Solace
description: Draw both tracks through a hurt ally to calm the breath and close their wounds.

name: Convergent Track
description: Bring both tracks together at the chest so the user strikes hard and stands firm in one beat.

name: Rejoined Breath
description: Rejoin both tracks of breath inside an ally who has just fallen still and call their breath back within moments.

name: Twofold Tide
description: Release inward and outward tracks together as a tide that crushes and then sweeps back across the ground.

name: Rising Current
description: Ride a rising current of qi up from the legs and leap over a low reach.

name: Hawk Beat
description: Strike twice in quick wing-like beats with the second carrying the stored qi.

name: Keen Filament
description: Send out one sharp thread that returns with the shape and speed of what it touched.

name: Lofty Veil
description: Hold the veil high over head and shoulders so falling and thrown blows are stopped.

name: Hawk Rake
description: Rake the fingers down the foe's guard with hooked qi and tear their grip loose.

name: Feather Mend
description: Brush the hurt of an ally or yourself with light qi that lifts pain like a feather.

name: Highest Stoop
description: Rise on the highest current then fall as one stroke with the full weight of qi behind it.

name: Far Surveying
description: Read the whole field from above and pass the pattern to allies so each moves with surer aim.

name: Crowning Stoop
description: Vanish upward on the highest current and reappear above the foe to land the crowning stroke.

name: Vow Thread
description: Speak a short vow and fling a thread of qi at a foe in clear sight.

name: Vow Brace
description: Vow to hold the line and set qi into the legs and spine against the push.

name: Vow Tread
description: Take a pace on the vow so the foot lands true and the line stays straight.

name: Vow Attunement
description: Feel who nearby has sworn an oath of their own by the steadiness of their qi.

name: Vow Knock
description: Knock hard against a foe's guard on the vow and break their rhythm.

name: Vow Cord
description: Bind a foe's limbs with threads sworn to hold until the vow is let go.

name: Vow Knit
description: Swear to a hurt ally that they will mend and lead steady qi into them to keep it.

name: Vow Tide
description: Send the whole sworn qi out as a rolling tide that presses on all in its path.

name: Vow Curtain
description: Hold a sworn ward round yourself and allies that blunts blows and steadies each one's strength.

name: Vow Everlasting
description: Hold the vow through the whole fight so the guard cannot be split and wounds close under it.

name: Plumb Beat
description: Strike straight down the plumb line of the body on the beat of the pulse.

name: Plumb Veil
description: Hang a veil of qi plumb before the chest so blows meet it square and stop.

name: Plumb Read
description: Read how far a foe's stance leans from true and which way they will fall.

name: Plumb Lance
description: Thrust a narrow line of qi straight through a gap in the foe's guard.

name: Plumb Slide
description: Slide forward along the plumb line without a sway and arrive inside the foe's reach.

name: Plumb Ease
description: Draw a hurt ally upright and ease their wounds with a level flow of qi.

name: Plumb Crush
description: Bring the full weight of a held bearing down on the foe and crush their stance flat.

name: Plumb Purge
description: Drain tainted qi from an ally straight down the body and out through the feet.

name: Plumb Verdict
description: Deliver the final stroke along a perfect bearing so that the foe is struck down and pinned in place.

name: Unhidden Pulse
description: Strike openly with a pulse of qi that the foe can see and still cannot avoid.

name: Unhidden Veil
description: Wear the veil in plain sight with no trick to it so the foe sees what they will hit.

name: Unhidden Stride
description: Stride straight at a foe on a bright path of qi with nothing concealed.

name: Unhidden Reading
description: Read a nearby body openly with a plain thread and let it know that it is read.

name: Unhidden Lash
description: Lash out with a visible whip of qi that cracks on the target.

name: Unhidden Seal
description: Press an open seal of qi on a foe and show them it is in place until they yield.

name: Unhidden Mend
description: Mend an ally in plain sight with a bright flow of qi that steadies the whole group.

name: Unhidden Tide
description: Send a broad visible tide across the ground that offers no hiding place from its force.

name: Unhidden Canopy
description: Spread the field open round all sworn to it so each stands firm and strong.

name: Unveiled Surge
description: Hold every thread of qi in plain view and loose them in a surge that nothing can slip.

name: Sworn Shroud
description: Pledge a light veil of qi over the body and hold it for as long as the pledge lasts.

name: Sworn Reach
description: Throw a sworn bolt of qi past arm's length at one foe.

name: Sworn Count
description: Count the allies and foes inside the sworn field by the qi each one carries.

name: Sworn Thread
description: Cast a sworn thread round a foe's wrists and hold them until it is released.

name: Sworn Knock
description: Knock hard on the foe's guard with qi sworn to carry through it.

name: Sworn Ease
description: Ease the hurt of those sworn within the field with a calm continuing flow.

name: Sworn Outburst
description: Burst the sworn field outward so every foe at its edge is struck and pushed back.

name: Sworn Mantling
description: Spread the field as a close cover over a whole company and strengthen each one beneath it.

name: Sworn Crescendo
description: Raise the sworn field in a swelling roar of qi that shields allies and crashes over foes.

name: Anchored Beat
description: Strike with the feet planted on a fixed anchor of qi so the pulse does not slip.

name: Anchored Veil
description: Fix the veil to its anchor so a blow cannot drag it away from the body.

name: Anchored Pace
description: Pace out from the anchor and return to it in one even breath.

name: Anchored Reading
description: Read the field from the anchor and note every shift in its pressure.

name: Anchored Thread
description: Tie a foe by a thread to the anchor so they can only move in a short circle.

name: Anchored Lance
description: Thrust a lance of qi from the anchor through a guard at the end of the line.

name: Anchored Mend
description: Draw steady qi from the anchor and mend a hurt ally or yourself in a slow even flow.

name: Anchored Tide
description: Release the anchor's stored qi as a tide that surges outward from the planted foot.

name: Anchored Recall
description: Draw the anchor's qi into an ally who has just stopped breathing and call them back within moments.

name: Anchored Judgment
description: Bring the anchor's whole stored weight down on one foe and crush their stance and will together.

name: Distant Thread
description: Cast a long thread of qi at a foe at the far edge of the field.

name: Distant Veil
description: Hold a veil of qi out in front of the body at the length of the arm.

name: Distant Divining
description: Read bodies at the farthest edge of the field through a single drifting thread.

name: Distant Pike
description: Cast a long lance of qi that pierces a guard from beyond a spear's length.

name: Distant Stride
description: Stretch a stride along the bearing to reach a foe at the far edge in one pace.

name: Distant Salve
description: Send mending qi a long way along a thread to heal an ally who cannot be reached.

name: Distant Upsurge
description: Throw a wide tide of qi to the far edge of the field and let it break there.

name: Distant Purge
description: Draw taint and sour backlash out of a far-off ally along a thread and burn it off.

name: Farthest Reach
description: Flash along the longest bearing and drive a lance through the farthest foe before they see it move.
